limitations: One recorded run proves graph execution and output structure only; effect quality, reference fidelity and temporal consistency remain unqualified.

Only the first 81 frames are restyled at about 0.4 megapixels with sides divisible by 16, at the source frame rate; the two generated reference frames are trimmed. No FPS, duration, timeline or segment control exists in this recipe.
Edge conditioning follows visible contours and can prevent intended clothing or geometry changes.
Mute only: source audio is not carried into the output.
